original.reason: It relies on an unspecified “previous proof” and an undefined “maximal subset” rather than directly considering an arbitrary subgroup properly containing H; the needed subgroup/maximality properties are not established within the proof.

judgment.reason: It correctly shows every subgroup properly containing the rotation subgroup contains a reflection and hence both generators r and s, so is the whole dihedral group.
It gives the standard complete maximality argument using the normal forms r^j and sr^j.
It correctly proves that any strict overgroup of the rotations equals the full group.
It incorrectly claims that K=D_{2n} contradicts K⊊D_{2n}, although only K⊆D_{2n} was assumed. The correct conclusion is available before that claim, but the stated contradiction is false.
